source.description: A colossal sandstone tomb guardian with glowing turquoise cracks and gold hieroglyphs, standing massive and still. Seamless loop.

The colossal sandstone guardian with glowing turquoise cracks attacks — it raises one massive square fist high overhead, then smashes it down toward the camera with a heavy impact, then grinds slowly back upright.

_notes: v3 humanoid character (boss), south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
